stem: A student graphs a point that is represented by the ordered pair (3, 0). In this ordered pair, what does the number 3 indicate?

options.label: F
options.text: The point is 3 units above 0 on the x-axis.

options.label: G
options.text: The point is 3 units above 0 on the y-axis.

options.label: H
options.text: The point is 3 units to the right of 0 on the y-axis.

options.label: J
options.text: The point is 3 units to the right of 0 on the x-axis.
